events.title: European Shares Seen Lower At Open
events.description: European stocks may drift lower at open on Thursday, with technology stocks likely to be in focus after the Wall Street Journal reported that SpaceX, Broadcom and Oracle were looking to raise money to buy AI chips, leaving investors worried about whether the expected profits will materialize.

events.title: Indian Shares Drift Lower In Cautious Trade; IT Stocks Buck Trend
events.description: Indian shares traded lower on Thursday amid lingering concerns about rising oil prices and elevated bond yields in international markets.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is extending its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, adding to the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian markets are trading mostly lower on Thursday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, as rising volatility in crude oil prices, global currency and bond yields continue to weigh on market sentiment. Technology stocks are also dragging the markets amid a surge in AI-related corporate debt. Asian markets closed mostly lower on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Set To Follow Asian Peers Lower
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening lower on Thursday as investors fret about rising volatility in global currency and bond markets.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Thai Stock Market
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in five straight sessions, gathering almost 25 points or 1.6 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,580-point plateau although it may run out of steam on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Japanese market is trading significantly lower on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling well below the 69,400 level, with weakness in index heavyweights, exporters, financial and technology stocks partially offset by gains in automaker stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Give Up Support At 6,100 Points
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday snapped the three-day winning streak in which it had improved almost 185 points or 2.8 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 6,150-point plateau and it's likely to open to the downside again on Thursday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May See Continued Consolidation
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Wednesday halted the two-day winning streak in which it had collected more than 300 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,130-point plateau and it's tipped to open under pressure again on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading modestly lower on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling to near the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May Return To Action On The Downside
events.description: Ahead of the long break for the National Day holiday, the China stock market had ticked higher in two straight sessions, adding almost 20 points or 0.5 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,840-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Thursday.

events.title: Taiwan Shares May Take Further Damage On Thursday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market and Wednesday wrote a finish to the five-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 2,150 points or 4.6 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 49,800-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Thursday.

events.title: Soft Start Anticipated For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Wednesday halted the two-day winning streak in which it had climbed more than 65 points or 1.2 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,600-point plateau and it's expected to open under water again on Thursday.
